Licensure of the Practice of Funeral Service, Funeral Directors and Embalmers

law.catch_line: Inapplicability to officers of state and local institutions
law.text: Nothing in this article shall be applicable to any officer of any institution operated by the Commonwealth or by any county, city or town in the performance of his duties as such.
